about.description: Tether Gold (XAUT) perpetual on Variational Omni (Arbitrum), USDC-margined RFQ perpetual quoted by the single Omni Liquidity Provider (OLP), which aggregates pricing from CEXs/DEXs/AMMs/OTC venues. Tracks the XAUT token price (each XAUT represents one troy ounce of physical gold custodied by TG Commodities S.A. de C.V., a Tether subsidiary), with up to 50x leverage, with zero trading fees, with OLP capturing spread, cash-settled in USDC. Distinct from variational:XAU (which tracks spot gold). This perpetual references the on-chain Tether Gold RWA token specifically.
